notes: Backend API not public (https://backend.davita.sa/graphql -> HTTP 401; https://backend.davita.sa/api/collections/recipes/entries -> HTTP 404), so pages were parsed from the Next.js RSC payload. listed = distinct English recipe slugs from /diet-nutrition (18), /ar/diet-nutrition (18) and the sitemap (18 recipe slugs; sitemap gives them at the site root, which soft-404s, so canonical URLs are /diet-nutrition/<slug>). The CMS listing query returns no pagination totals; listing and sitemap agree. scraped = English recipe pages with a recipe entry; 17 of them also have official Arabic text (/ar/diet-nutrition/<slug>). 10 already exist in davita_recipes.db (matches.json, images downloaded); only the 8 new recipes are in recipes.json, as 8 English + 7 Arabic records (translation_of = English source_id). listed/scraped/with_image/with_nutrients all count English site recipes (matched + new). skipped counts entries in skipped.json (the sitemap root-URL aliases are one entry). Matching: normalised title vs DB English canonical rows; 'title+nutrients' when calories/Na/K/P/protein agree within max(10%, 10 units / 1 g) on all but at most one; when they disagree, a title match is kept only if the ingredient lists overlap >= 0.7 (word overlap coefficient). Title-only matches (nutrients differ): ['Barley and Beef Stew -> Barley and Beef Stew (exact (ingredient overlap 0.95))', 'Bavarian Apple Tart -> Bavarian Apple Tart (exact (ingredient overlap 0.92))', 'Creamy Cucumber Spread -> Creamy Cucumber Spread (exact (ingredient overlap 1.00))', 'Grilled Marinated Chicken -> Grilled Marinated Chicken (exact (ingredient overlap 0.87))']. Same title but judged a DIFFERENT recipe (kept as new): ["Chicken Fajita vs DB 3981 'Chicken Fajitas' (nutrients differ, ingredient overlap 0.50)", "Vegetarian Pizza vs DB 3483 'Vegetarian Pizza' (nutrients differ, ingredient overlap 0.44)"]. Near-title matches accepted because nutrients agree: ['Slow cooker Mixed Fruit Recipe -> Slow Cooker Mixed Fruit Pudding (near-title (word overlap 0.80))']. Images: original asset permalinks (ourassets.site/davita/...) used instead of signed Glide crops (?w=500/410, signature prevents resizing); dimensions 1800x1240. English steps were PDF line-wrapped and were rejoined where a line lacked closing punctuation and the next began lowercase; Arabic text is kept exactly as published (including wrap fragments). Arabic records reuse the English numeric nutrients and diet values; Arabic nutrition strings are in nutrients_raw. Portions/serving size parsed from hints ('Serving is for N', 'Portions: N Serving Size: X'). Data caveat: chicken-fajita, eggplants-roll and pumpkin-soup (video recipes) publish implausible per-serving values (e.g. phosphorus 1000-1100 mg, sodium 1882 mg, fiber 15-27 g) with no portion count; kept exactly as published. Not scraped: cookbook PDFs and the i18n-only mango recipe (see skipped.json).
